instructions.core_directive:
Use case: Services that depend on retire or prohibited technology and have open incidents.

Use the `ask` intent tool with this question in plain language against the seeded CMDB and TRM data (records labelled `[orch-test]`). Use `find` first when you need the class or source names. Do not query ServiceNow directly.

Expected path: Retire or prohibited technology is on db01, web02, app02 and batch01; the applications on them are Billing Engine, Payments and Reporting; the services are Customer Billing, Online Ordering and Supply Chain.

A correct answer: Open incidents A (db01), B (app02) and D (batch01) are returned. Customer Support is clean and is excluded; incident F is resolved and is excluded. It names the source of each fact and says plainly when the seed data is not present in the instance.
